terms.definition: A user-selected serving folder, not an arbitrary system directory.
The native app serves files; the extension launches or controls it.
Access on the local network does not imply public internet access.
List files when no index.html exists, not upload permission.
Android/desktop policy differs; iOS stops on background.
Explicitly start the listener; opening a launcher is distinct.
Stops serving, retaining the selected folder and settings.
Numeric port; 0 selects an available port.
Serving does not grant file modification.
Browser surface controls a separately installed native server.
